title: ConversationQueryResponse
description: Schema for audited conversational analytics responses conforming to EIOS Principle I.

route.description: Domain specialist agent responsible for the query.

response_markdown.description: Audited executive prose output with citations.

citations.description: Entity IDs and data product references cited in the narrative.

evidence_ledger.description: Structured tool outputs backing quantitative assertions.

staged_recommendation.description: Non-autonomous recommendation card and draft action intent proposal if applicable.

is_replay_fallback.description: True if output was served from circuit-breaker cached replay.

turn_latency_ms.description: Total round-trip turn execution time in milliseconds.

reflection_cycles_used.description: Number of coordinator arbitration cycles executed.
